Title: General availability: UltraPerformance Gateway tier for Azure ExpressRoute

Body.Content:
UltraPerformance Gateway connects a virtual network to an Azure ExpressRoute circuit and provides five times the network throughput of HighPerformance Gateway. Customers can now deploy more network-intensive workloads in their virtual networks.

For information about pricing, please visit the VPN Gateway pricing page.
